event_summary: A small gray round object enters from the left, passes behind a stationary white open container on a tabletop, and exits to the right.
raw_event_description: The video begins with a white, upright, open-top rectangular container standing on a light wood-grain tabletop. The container remains in the same position throughout. After several still moments, a small gray round or short cylindrical object appears from the left side of the frame on the tabletop, travels rightward behind the container, is briefly hidden by the container, reappears on the container's right side, continues rightward, and leaves the frame. A dark rounded object at the far left edge remains stationary.

reasons: The white open container and tabletop are clearly visible.
The later-moving gray object is not yet visible in the first frame.
